requirements.invariant: StandardChange models are versioned, bounded, low-risk and exact-constraint matched.
Every change declares an explicit recovery strategy with rationale where required.
requirements.failure: Missing/invalid plan -> not execution eligible downstream

requirements.invariant: Rollback targets use exact immutable and compatibility identities.
Irreversible steps and point-of-no-return are explicit before execution.
Maintenance windows carry timezone, start/end, action/target scope and explicit override authority.
requirements.failure: Outside window -> wait or valid explicit override

requirements.invariant: Verification success criteria are predeclared, versioned and bound to the exact change revision.
requirements.failure: Missing criteria -> no material execution grant downstream

acceptance: all six requirements must have executable passing evidence
